descriptors.concept_name: Audit Reporting on Corresponding Figures and Comparative Financial Statements
descriptors.definition: The auditor formats opinions differently depending on whether corresponding figures or comparative financial statements are presented. Specific paragraphs are used when prior period opinions differ or when predecessor auditor reports are referenced.
exclusion: Current period unverified balances without opening balance checks
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes between single period corresponding figures and multi-period comparative financial statements.

descriptors.concept_name: SA 720 The Auditor's Responsibilities Relating to Other Information
descriptors.definition: Auditors must read and evaluate financial and non-financial other information included in an entity's annual report to identify material inconsistencies. This process helps safeguard the credibility of the audited financial statements and the auditor's report.
inclusion: Comparing other information with financial statements
nearby_distinctions: Differs from substantive financial statement testing by focusing on consistency rather than direct verification of non-financial metrics.

descriptors.definition: The auditor aims to detect material inconsistencies between other information and either the financial statements or audit knowledge. Appropriate responses and reporting protocols are initiated when misstatements are identified.
exclusion: Direct auditing of items outside the annual report scope
nearby_distinctions: Targets consistency checks rather than forming an independent assurance conclusion on the other information itself.

descriptors.concept_name: Obtaining and Reading Other Information Procedures
descriptors.definition: The auditor collaborates with management to determine the annual report documents and ensures timely receipt prior to or after the audit report date. While reading, the auditor remains alert for indicators of material misstatements not linked to the financials.
inclusion: Discussions with management on report timelines
Obtaining written representations for delayed reports
exclusion: Accepting final documents without review if obtainable prior to report date
nearby_distinctions: Focuses on information acquisition and baseline reading rather than modification of the primary opinion.

descriptors.concept_name: Responding to Material Inconsistencies or Misstatements in Other Information
descriptors.definition: When potential inconsistencies emerge, the auditor engages with management and executes additional procedures to determine if misstatements exist in the other information or financial statements. Uncorrected errors require escalation to those charged with governance or potential engagement withdrawal.
exclusion: Issuing standard reports when uncorrected material errors persist without evaluation
nearby_distinctions: Differentiates responses based on whether the other information was obtained before or after the audit report date.

descriptors.concept_name: Auditor Actions on Uncorrected Other Information Misstatements
descriptors.definition: If management refuses to correct identified misstatements, the auditor communicates with governance and evaluates reporting implications or legal withdrawal options. For post-report discoveries, the auditor takes appropriate legal steps to bring uncorrected errors to user attention.
inclusion: Communication with those charged with governance
exclusion: Direct alteration of the other information by the auditor
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes between pre-report and post-report discovery workflows for uncorrected material items.

descriptors.concept_name: Required Other Information Section in Audit Report
descriptors.definition: Auditors must include a designated Other Information section in the audit report under specified entity conditions, outlining management responsibility and stating that no assurance is expressed thereon. It also details whether the auditor has anything to report or needs to describe an uncorrected misstatement.
exclusion: Providing an audit opinion or assurance conclusion on the other information
nearby_distinctions: Distinct from the main opinion paragraph, acting as a transparency disclosure rather than an attestation.

descriptors.concept_name: Mandatory Inclusion of Other Information Reporting Section
descriptors.definition: The audit report must feature a dedicated section detailing management obligations, identification of reviewed documents, and an explicit lack of assurance on other information. This requirement triggers based on whether the entity is listed or unlisted and if documents are obtained.
inclusion: Mandatory section generation for listed entities expecting other information
Conditional section generation for unlisted entities
exclusion: Omitting the section when other information is neither obtained nor expected for unlisted entities
nearby_distinctions: Applies varying triggers depending on the corporate classification of the audited entity.

descriptors.concept_name: Statutory Prescription for Other Information Reporting
descriptors.definition: When regulations mandate specific layouts for referencing other information, the auditor may reference Standards on Auditing only if minimum content requirements like scope identification and outcome statements are met. This standard governs the boundaries of auditor liability regarding supplementary disclosures.
inclusion: Minimum compliance elements for statutory wording
References to auditing standards alongside regulatory formats
exclusion: Referring to SAs when mandated minimum elements are omitted
nearby_distinctions: Balances customized regulatory reporting templates against the baseline requirements of auditing standards.

descriptors.concept_name: Auditor Statutory Inquiry Duties Under Section 143
descriptors.definition: Statutory provisions require company auditors to inquire into specific operational matters, such as loan securities, book entries, and share allotments. A separate report to members is necessitated only if the auditor uncovers adverse findings requiring special commentary.
inclusion: Inquiries into security of loans and advances
Checking cash receipts for share allotments
exclusion: Filing positive confirmation reports when statutory inquiries reveal no adverse conditions
nearby_distinctions: Differs from general financial statement verification by focusing on specific statutory compliance checks mandated by corporate law.

descriptors.concept_name: CARO 2020 Additional Reporting Framework and Applicability
descriptors.definition: Issued under statutory authority, the order mandates additional reporting disclosures for eligible companies alongside the primary audit report. Specific entity types, such as banking companies, insurance entities, and small companies meeting specific criteria, are exempt from these extra requirements.
inclusion: Exemption evaluations for small and private companies
nearby_distinctions: Acts as an supplementary reporting order rather than the standard financial statement audit opinion.

descriptors.concept_name: Illustrative Audit Report with Emphasis of Matter
descriptors.definition: An independent auditor's report contains structured sections including the opinion, basis of opinion, and key audit matters. An emphasis of matter paragraph draws attention to critical disclosures, such as facility damage, without modifying the core audit opinion.
exclusion: Modifying the auditor opinion due to disclosed emphasis items
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes between explanatory emphasis paragraphs and actual modifications or qualifications of the audit opinion.
